tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand green. Header and tab bar ground, every Newsreader heading and figure, active chips/segments/pages, the hero Pick button, the inverse TBR pick card. Text: 9.7:1 on paper, 9.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Graphic green only: bar-chart fills and heatmap level 4. Never small text.

tokens.name: emerald-ink
tokens.usage: Action green: primary button fills (white label 5.5:1), links, series line, focus ring, input focus border, hover state of outline controls (5.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Tint: running status chip, + Add Book button, Owned badge, checked platform chips, focus halo, Start Reading on the pick card. forest on it 8.6:1.

tokens.name: mint-on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and accents on forest: header subtitle, active tab underline, author and series on the pick card (7.6:1).

tokens.name: sage-on-forest
tokens.usage: Meta text on forest (pick card page count, 5.6:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground; also paused-card, Wrapped-cell, speed-record and series-list grounds; table row hover.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Every card, panel, table, dialog and input; text on forest and emerald-ink fills.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, bar track, genre-tag badge ground, paused status chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and row/section hairlines (decorative, 1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (pills, inputs, outline buttons), dashed empty/paused cards, table header rule, empty stars.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Input border on hover (3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and book titles on paper and bg (16:1); toast and tooltip ground.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary strong text: control labels, bar labels, outline-button labels (9.9:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Authors, uppercase labels, sub-captions, counts (5.9:1 on paper, 5.5:1 on bg).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta (card size line, projected figures). 4.6:1 on paper; use on paper, not on wash.

tokens.name: dramione
tokens.usage: Dramione only: its segmented option, AO3 badge text, Dramione Corner dot and figures (6.0:1 on paper).

tokens.name: dramione-wash
tokens.usage: Dramione cell and AO3 badge ground.

tokens.name: dramione-on-forest
tokens.usage: The pink dot on the + Add Dramione header button.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: DNF button label/hover border, DNF status chip text, Delete fill on hover (6.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: DNF hover and DNF status chip ground.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: DNF and Delete resting border.

tokens.name: star
